color.$description: Colours that do not vary by theme: the inks that sit on a coloured fill, and the tint alpha the status containers are built from.

on-accent-2.$description: Foreground on the light --accent-2 ramp step. zinc-950, the same ink as the light theme's --text.

alpha-tint.$description: The alpha a status colour is tinted to when it backs a container (a warning banner, a danger ghost button). Paired with the matching *-strong foreground, which is what keeps the label at AA.
